ledger_scope.definition: P8 eligibility and paired U/V fixed point on the common-video base; final paired users and categories are frozen before each bucket's categorized full video support is restored

paired_scope.definition: standard users with at least min_categories, intersected with random user IDs; common-video and standard-coverage restrictions iterated to a fixed point

novelty_note: The contribution is an audit protocol and estimand organization; the additive path and inner-product reconstruction are not claimed as new mathematical identities.

path_definition.support_term_note: each full-minus-common contrast includes the exclusive-video rows and the induced renormalization of retained video weights
path_definition.within_video_residual_plus_video_mix: standard_common_mean - random_common_mean, using the symmetric common-video decomposition

random_share_weighted_squared_error_ledg.definition: with D=sum_j g_j and random-full row-exposure weights w: level contribution_j=mean_w(g_j)*mean_w(D); shape contribution_j=<g_j-mean_w(g_j), D-mean_w(D)>_w; signed contributions sum exactly to the corresponding squared errors

warning: Descriptive accounting only, not causal attribution. The four-term path is an exact algebraic audit of observed log summaries, not a new identity.
